title: Split MCP wire primitives, JSON values, pagination, and protocol errors
description: TASK-029 defined MCP client/resource/prompt/sampling roots, and TASK-066 covers real transport. The current Rust MCP `types.rs` concentrates errors, names, URIs, JSON values, JSON schema, and pagination. Split wire primitives before JSON-RPC transport framing and bridge registration make the file a protocol catch-all.

files.change: Move error, name/URI, JSON value/object/schema, pagination, and future JSON-RPC framing primitives into focused modules.
Keep client lifecycle state using wire primitives without owning serialization or transport framing.

criteria: MCP domain modules consume shared typed wire primitives through a facade.
JSON value/schema conversion is testable without client lifecycle or transport code.
Future stdio/HTTP JSON-RPC framing can attach without bloating `types.rs`.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-mcp && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
